name: A Lesson in Divinity
summary: Deathguard Billmuth needs you to recover Scarlet Crusade attack plans from Venomweb Vale. The Deathguard expects an assault and hopes the plans will help prepare an ambush.

sections.title: Orders for the Keep
sections.body: Scarlet Crusaders carry deployment orders in their satchels, and the Deathguard expects an attack. Bring a copy of the plans to Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep. Then the Deathguard can prepare an ambush.

sections.title: A Friend Saved
sections.body: Billmuth thanks you for saving his friend and says he will take the plans to his commander. Your actions have shown him you are Forsaken through and through, despite the mistrust some of his people hold toward your class.

faq.answer: Deathguard Billmuth asks you to recover the Scarlet Crusade's attack plans from Venomweb Vale.
The Scarlet Crusaders at Venomweb Vale carry the attack plans.

faq.q: Why does the Deathguard want the plans?
faq.answer: The Deathguard expects an attack and wants the plans so it can prepare an ambush.
Bring the plans to Deathguard Billmuth at Bandarion Keep.

attribution: In-game quest text: A Lesson in Divinity
